The opportunity We are looking for a Global Segment Marketing Lead to strengthen our market- and customer-driven approach to growth within the Global Marketing team of the Transformers Business Unit. In this role, you will connect market and industry dynamics with our portfolio and capabilities, working closely with industry leaders and Product Management to understand customer applications, evolving needs, buying priorities, and where our solutions can create differentiated value. You will lead the development of segment- and application-specific value propositions and marketing strategies, translating market insights into clear value-selling points, differentiated positioning, and compelling marketing assets. The role requires a strong customer- and market-oriented mindset and the ability to move from understanding markets and customer needs to defining where and how we compete, differentiate, and deliver value. How You Will Make An Impact Partner with industry leaders and market experts to build a deep understanding of customer applications, industry ecosystems, emerging trends, and the role our portfolio plays within them. Lead the development of customer value propositions for key segments and applications, translating portfolio capabilities into differentiated customer outcomes and business value. Build a structured understanding of customer needs, pain points, buying criteria, decision-makers, and buying journeys, ensuring marketing priorities are anchored in real market demand. Translate segment strategies into clear marketing frameworks, defining target customers, positioning, key messages, value-selling points, and thought-leadership priorities. Work closely with the Communications team to ensure a consistent messaging framework, while adapting narratives and content to different audiences and purposes, from customer-facing communications to thought leadership. Collaborate with Product Management to connect market needs and customer value with portfolio positioning, product launches, and growth initiatives. Equip Sales and customer-facing teams with compelling customer value narratives and segment-specific marketing tools that enable stronger, value-based customer conversations. Define meaningful KPIs to measure the effectiveness of segment marketing strategies and continuously refine priorities based on market feedback and business impact. Your background Degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related discipline. Strong experience in B2B marketing, strategic marketing, segment marketing, business development, or commercial strategy, ideally within an industrial, energy, infrastructure, or technology environment. Strong market and commercial orientation, with the ability to understand complex industries, customer applications, value chains, and business models. Demonstrated ability to develop market segmentation, customer insights, value propositions, positioning, and go-to-market strategies. Strong analytical and strategic thinking, combined with the ability to turn strategy into actionable priorities. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. Comfortable operating in a global, cross-functional environment, navigating multiple segments and stakeholders with different levels of maturity and market dynamics. Excellent English knowledge 15% willingness to travel More About Us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a work place where personal and organizational success grow together. The minimum salary for this position in the location specified is as follows: Italy: starting from: 44,800 € gross annual The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. Our Benefits Offering For This Role Generally Includes Incentive Plan, Lunch tickets, Health Insurance, Pension Fund, Welfare, Flexible working hours, Hybrid work model, Well-being platform, Family Care Benefits, Parking and Partnerships (gyms, sports centers, stores). Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life As Country Business Manager Italy – Aortic, you will lead the Aortic business in Italy with full accountability for the country’s commercial performance, financial results and organizational effectiveness. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of a strategic business, accelerating sustainable growth while strengthening customer partnerships and team performance. You will have the opportunity to influence the future direction of the Aortic business, combining strategic thinking, strong commercial leadership and a passion for improving outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals. The role is based in Italy, with Milan as the reporting location, and operates in a predominantly remote working environment. The position requires regular travel across the country to engage with customers, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare institutions and the local team, as well as participation in relevant European and global business activities. The Country Business Manager reports into the relevant Aortic regional leadership structure and works closely with cross-functional partners across Sales, Marketing, Medical Education, Clinical, Medical Science, Finance, Human Resources and Operations to ensure strong execution of the country strategy. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: Own the full Profit & Loss (P&L) for the Italy Aortic business, delivering revenue, profitability and growth objectives in line with company strategy and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments Define and execute the country commercial strategy, translating regional and global priorities into clear business plans and measurable actions for the Italian market Lead, develop and engage the Italy Aortic organization, establishing a high-performance culture, strengthening capabilities and ensuring clear accountability across the team Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare institutions and other relevant stakeholders to strengthen Medtronic’s position and identify opportunities for sustainable growth Drive cross-functional execution across Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Market Access, Finance, Human Resources and Operations to maximize business performance and customer impact Monitor market dynamics, competitive activity and business performance, translating insights into strategic priorities, resource allocation and corrective actions Ensure disciplined execution of business processes, compliance requirements and governance standards while maintaining a strong focus on customer needs and patient outcomes Required Knowledge and Experience: Significant experience within Medtronic, with a strong understanding of the company’s culture, operating model, governance and matrix organization Proven commercial leadership experience within Medtronic or the medical technology industry, with accountability for business performance, revenue growth and execution of strategic priorities Demonstrated experience managing a Profit & Loss (P&L), including financial planning, resource allocation, revenue performance and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) delivery Proven track record of leading and developing teams, creating accountability, strengthening capabilities and delivering results through others Strong understanding of the Italian healthcare environment, including customer dynamics, hospital decision-making processes and relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies, translating regional and global strategies OQEMA Italy ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da OQEMA Italy. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 45,00 €/yr - 50,00 €/anno JOB DESCRIPTION /RESPONSABILITA’ In coordinamento con il Senior Sales Manager e il Responsabile di funzione, opererà nel team commerciale gestendo, sia la clientela acquisita che quella potenziale. Sviluppa e gestisce il portafoglio clienti che gli è stato assegnato in modo proattivo, elabora e negozia offerte, conduce trattative, si occupa del post vendita. Nel perimetro delle strategie direzionali si occupa del contatto con nuovi clienti, sviluppa attività di business development, partecipa ad eventi commerciali e fiere. Frequenta training tecnici di aggiornamento. Si interfaccia con colleghe/i delle unità estere. Contribuisce a raggiungere gli obiettivi della BU. Obiettivi di performance : Inizialmente gestisce il portafoglio clienti assegnato con successivo sviluppo in termini di numero di nuovi clienti acquisiti, ampliamento numero dei prodotti venduti, acquisizione informazioni di mercato. Provvede ad azioni di sviluppo e crescita del fatturato, dei volumi e margini. Provvede a fornire ai clienti un servizio pre e post vendita, creando un rapporto fiduciario e di fidelizzazione. Raggiunge nel breve la capacità di operare in progressiva autonomia nella gestione del cliente e di situazioni anche complesse. REQUISIT I: • Formazione: Background tecnico (scuola superiore perito chimico, agrario, tessile, biologia o analogo). Istruzione superiore in Chimica (Diploma di laurea, Laurea Magistrale o equivalenti). • Esperienza: almeno 3/5 anni di esperienze commerciali pregresse nel settore CASE. • E’ gradita la conoscenza pregressa del mercato delle materie prime industriali e considerato un plus la conoscenza del mercato dei solventi. • E’ richiesta una conoscenza base di marketing ed analisi approfondita dei dati (es. CRM). • Buona conoscenza e utilizzo di applicativi Microsoft Office/365 • Consolidata esperienza con strumenti e metodologie di analisi dei dati per supportare il processo decisionale. Capacità di organizzazione e pianificazione, tracciamento e quantificazione delle proprie attività (analisi di base di KPI, preparazione report). • Capacità di cooperare con tutte le funzioni aziendali e orientamento al lavoro di squadra ai fini del raggiungimento degli obiettivi assegnati. Mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati con passione per il miglioramento continuo • Capacità di adattamento ai vari contesti (diversità dei clienti e diversità delle applicazioni). Solide capacità analitiche, organizzative. Attitudine al problem-solving e all’innovazione. • Leadership, visione strategica, capacità decisionale e orientamento ai risultati. • Abilità comunicative efficaci, in grado di coinvolgere e influenzare stakeholders a tutti i livelli • Capacità di affermarsi in un ambiente dinamico e frenetico e di adattarsi alle priorità in evoluzione • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (B2 o superiore), scritta e parlata. E’ gradita, come plus, la conoscenza di altra lingua. SEDE di LAVORO : Assago (MI). E’ richiesta disponibilità a trasferte. Range retributivo: € 45-50 Sarai accolto in un ambiente dinamico, innovativo e lavorerai in un team giovane e motivato con opportunità di crescita professionale. Avrai accesso a programmi di formazione professionale che ti consentiranno di accrescere le tue competenze. Pacchetto retributivo e benefit competitivi, con possibilità di assumere ruoli di maggiore responsabilità.
